No matte, gradient, rimlight, shadow halo, extra props, borders or lettering.

Keep one dark red central sac visible in a partially occluded side silhouette, THREE thick roots and the same broad root shapes. Reduce the tiny rubble and jagged contour points to only two big quiet bottom stones. This is attached to a dungeon WALL crevice, never a free-standing decorative pillar or pot. Matte desaturated browns and oxblood with large black occlusion. No halo, UI outline, glow or decorative border.
